gregsteamexpansion.machine.large_steam_a: One controller slot holds 1–4 stacked electric assemblers of a single tier (LV–EV); kinds cannot be mixed, and the stack persists across reloads.
Empty slot: ULV recipes only at parallel 1; a stacked kind admits recipes up to its own tier.
Stacks of 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 raise the parallel cap to 2 / 4 / 8 / 16; a running batch keeps its locked tier and parallel.
Batch duration = recipe duration × 1.5 × time ladder; steam per tick = recipe EU/t × 2 × steam ladder (integer math).
Ladder at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 parallel: steam ×1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2, duration ×1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 — higher parallel lowers steam cost per item.
Actual parallel = min(cap, input portions, worst-case output room); a steam shortage rewinds progress to 1 tick and the batch resumes.
Easy difficulty doubles item outputs of new batches; Normal and Expert stay 1× — inputs are never discounted.
Industrial casings form the top/bottom faces and all 12 edges; the four walls (steam machine casings) are the only hatch zone with ≤16 hatches in total.
18 Steam Assembly Blocks sit on interior layers 2 and 8 (3×3 spaced grids); exactly one Steam Exhaust Hatch is required.
Breaking the controller returns the slot's assemblers as item drops; the preference recipe and pending outputs are lost.
9×9×9 large steam assembler running the full gtceu:assembler recipe type with pure steam power.
The controller's assembler slot gates recipe tiers and parallel with electric assemblers; it never provides EU (2 mB steam per EU).
Hold Shift for slot, parallel ladder and structure details.
gregsteamexpansion.machine.large_steam_b: Fixed three-stage tapered megastructure, 13×13 footprint and 15 tall (733 solid blocks): the hearth is a 48-block industrial ring (incl. the front-centre controller) around a 121-block coke-brick bed; the 13×13 tuyere deck and nine 11×11 shaft layers are walled in blast bricks (368, gtceu:firebricks - the primitive blast furnace's own material); a solid 9×9 throat cap and the 5×5×3 chimney crown complete the taper.

The coke-brick hearth bed is structure-only and grants no bonuses. The walls alone take ~370 blast bricks (≈ 1,500 fireclay bricks) — a true megaproject in bricks; wrought iron stays reserved for the controller and the steel machinery it unlocks.

Hatches replace ONLY wall blast brick positions: at least 1 item input bus, 1 item output bus and 1 steam supply hatch, EXACTLY 1 steam exhaust hatch, at least 1 steam air intake hatch (tuyere, up to 8), at most 28 hatches in total. No fluid hatch of any family is admissible. Full-load reference: 16 supply hatches + 2 buses + 1 exhaust + 8 tuyeres = 27.

Runs every gtceu:primitive_blast_furnace recipe (steel from iron or wrought iron plus coal, charcoal or coke; wrought iron comes from iron dust + fuel here, on top of the upstream iron nugget smelting route); one recipe per batch, up to 96 parallel, duration = base × 0.4 (rounded up) — 240× the primitive blast furnace's throughput.

The recipe type carries no EU/t: steam is a flat 200 mB/t per parallel — 19,200 mB/t at full load, exactly 16 supply hatches at their 1,200 mB/t caps. Every consuming tick also draws blast air at 4 mB/t per parallel (384 mB/t full load) across the tuyeres; each intake collects 50 mB/t, so sustained full load needs ALL 8 tuyeres. An air or steam shortfall rolls the batch back to 1 tick and the status shows blast air shortage when air runs out.
Outputs only leave through the item output buses; worst-case outputs are prechecked before startup and are never voided.
The steam exhaust hatch must face open air (3 blocks straight ahead); an obstructed exhaust freezes progress and vents nothing until cleared, and venting deals heat damage on its cycle.
The last successful recipe is preferred; active pause freezes progress; loss of steam, blast air or structure rolls an active batch back to 1 tick.
Removing the controller drops only pending outputs and loses the recipe preference; the controller holds no internal item storage.
All three difficulty tiers behave identically.

A pure-steam MEGASTRUCTURE blast furnace running ALL gtceu:primitive_blast_furnace recipes (iron dust + fuel → wrought iron, iron or wrought iron + fuel → steel) at up to 96 parallel operations — 240× the primitive blast furnace's throughput.

Colossal three-stage tapered tower, 13×13 at the base and 15 tall, walled in ~370 blast bricks; each recipe takes 0.4× its base duration with a flat 200 mB of steam per tick per parallel plus scaling tuyere air.
Hold Shift for the full structure and operating rules.
